prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "en effekt". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "effect".
Scene: A clear before-and-after view of the same wilting plant becoming upright after watering, one watering can between the two views and a gold arrow showing the effect.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "effekt = effect or result.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Förändringen hade en tydlig effekt.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
Use attached image ONLY for style and layout, accurate text and Swedish diacritics. One square image.
